steps.caption: Open Deals under Records: every opportunity, in columns by stage.
'Show lost / dormant' brings back closed deals. New opportunity is at the bottom.
Open a deal in Research — Marigold Loop.
Top cards: expected fee (a forecast), then invoiced, recognised and collected — real money only.
The stage bar: green = done, blue = now, grey = still to come.
Move to: the next stage is already chosen — Approach attempted.
Add a reason. Later stages require one; it is kept in the stage history.
Moved: the deal is now in Approach attempted.
Stage history keeps every move with its reason.
Labels & outcome: temperature, mandate, next action and expected close; set won/lost here too.
Closing checklist: items 'needed before' a stage block it until done (with proof) or waived.
Fees: each amount has its own status — a forecast never counts as invoiced or collected.
Some moves are blocked. Back to Deals, open Kestrelbay Payments.
Try Requirement confirmed, with a reason, and press Move stage.
Blocked: the linked requirement must be client-confirmed first. It is still 'estimated'.
Open the requirement to confirm its facts with the client first.
Client confirmation lists what the client still has to confirm.
Changes from captures, imports or the official CRM wait in Review for your OK.
